reference.source: Unmodified official Ant Design UMD with public top-level style.height32/60/32 and root-only style.transition=none. Actual browser geometry models the existing Native intrinsic auto-height jump without introducing a new root height interpolation; popup motion and all actions remain unchanged. No expected geometry corrections.
reference.phaseControl: Public requestAnimationFrame callbacks advance explicitly. Own-node Animations are paused on discovery and sampled with explicit currentTime followed by one public render frame. All snapshots preserve actual DOM/CSS, including before/start/active, no-CSS stalls and Source lifecycle quirks.

counterpart.reason: Published public height32/60/32 expresses the established Native intrinsic auto-height flow. Source root transition:all .2s would otherwise interpolate an authored numeric height, adding an effect absent from intrinsic auto-height. Disable that root transition while preserving the unchanged popup animation and action sequence.
